# App Store

> Apple's App Store is the primary digital marketplace for discovering, browsing, and downloading apps and games across iPhone, iPad, Apple Watch, Apple TV, and Vision Pro.

The App Store serves as Apple's curated ecosystem for mobile and cross-platform applications, featuring editorial recommendations, category browsing, and subscription services like Apple Arcade. It hosts millions of apps from developers worldwide, ranging from productivity tools to games, with a focus on discovery and user experience across Apple's device ecosystem.

## Platform Hubs

- [Today for iPhone - App Store](https://apps.apple.com/us/iphone/today): App Store editorial homepage featuring curated app and game recommendations for iPhone
- [Today for iPad - App Store](https://apps.apple.com/us/ipad/today): App Store editorial showcase with curated apps and games for iPad
- [Apps for Watch - App Store](https://apps.apple.com/us/watch/apps-and-games): App Store collection of watchOS apps for Apple Watch
- [Discover for TV - App Store](https://apps.apple.com/us/tv/discover): App Store discovery page for tvOS apps and streaming services
- [Apps & Games for Vision - App Store](https://apps.apple.com/us/vision/apps-and-games): App Store catalog for Vision Pro and visionOS immersive experiences

## iPhone Apps & Games

- [Apps for iPhone - App Store](https://apps.apple.com/us/iphone/apps): App Store apps category and discovery for iPhone
- [Games for iPhone - App Store](https://apps.apple.com/us/iphone/games): App Store games category and browsing for iPhone
- [Arcade for iPhone - App Store](https://apps.apple.com/us/iphone/arcade): Apple Arcade subscription games collection for iPhone

## Featured & Trending Games

- [Top Games Right Now - App Store](https://apps.apple.com/us/iphone/story/id1494784728): App Store editorial feature showcasing trending games
- [5 Speedy Tips for Mario Kart Tour - App Store](https://apps.apple.com/us/iphone/story/id1533872240): Gameplay guide and tips for Mario Kart Tour racing mechanics
